title: Embedding a Silent Configuration
statement: Let $m,k$ be nonnegative integers, let $\iota$ be an injective map from the $m$ work-tape indices into the $k$ work-tape indices, and choose a distinguished tape index $c$ among the $k$ tapes. Given tape contents $T_j:\mathbb Z\to\mathrm{Option}(\mathrm{Symbol})$, head positions $h_j\in\mathbb Z$, lists $p,o_0$ of symbols, and an $m$-tape configuration $C$ on input $x$, form a $k$-tape configuration on the same input. It keeps $C$’s state and input-head position, places each of its work tapes and heads at the index specified by $\iota$, and at every unused index other than $c$ uses $T_j$ and $h_j$. At index $c$, its tape contains the concatenation of $p$ and $C$’s output, its head is at the length of that concatenation, and its output is $o_0$.
hypotheses_covered: An injection from the $m$ tape indices into the $k$ tape indices
A distinguished index among the $k$ tapes
Supplied tape contents and head positions for the $k$ tapes
A prefix list and an output list
An $m$-tape configuration on the fixed input
